note: Reservation-only campground among the boulder piles near Ryan Mountain in the middle of Joshua Tree NP; sites are sandy and set between the rocks, and trails to Ryan Mountain and Cap Rock leave nearby. Generators may run only 7-9 am, noon-2 pm and 5-7 pm. Drinking water and supplies are in Twentynine Palms, 17 mi away. --Claude
